summary: The Mosaic Company filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $2.0 billion senior notes offering (5.350% notes due 2031, 5.650% notes due 2034, 5.900% notes due 2036) under an underwriting agreement. Net proceeds of approximately $1,983.3 million are intended to fund tender offers for up to $1.4 billion of existing notes, plus general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing and refinancing transaction, not a special situation.
